title: Spotify Memberships
one_liner: Fans pay a monthly membership you set up on Spotify for bonus podcast content.
followers: None. You need 100 listeners and 100 hours listened on Spotify in the last 30 days.
pay: Creators keep 90% of revenue; you set the tiers and prices. Example only: 20 members at $5 = $100, you keep $90.
steps: Host the show on Spotify for Creators or Megaphone.
Reach 100 listeners and 100 consumption hours in 30 days.
Set up your tiers and the bonus content members get.
catch: Live in 34 markets only; fans must be Free or Premium users in those markets, and you only get contact details from fans who opt in.

match.first_step: Publish 3 episodes on Spotify for Creators and aim for 100 listeners.
